ModMetaData.name: Total Fog
ModMetaData.author: Andreas Pardeike
ModMetaData.description:
You only know what your colonists can see.
Real fog of war for RimWorld: the map stays dark until someone looks, and explored land turns grey when nobody is watching. Raids come out of the dark, and a noise at night might be anything.
Build surveillance cameras, a watch telescope and watchtowers to see farther. Four settings pages let you choose how strict it gets, from light atmosphere to hard survival with hidden sounds, delayed news, silent raids and enemies that only shoot at what they see.
Needs Harmony. Turn off other Real Fog of War versions; Total Fog takes over their explored maps.
Feedback: https://discord.gg/G4r84eN7w6 Source: https://github.com/pardeike/TotalFog
Based on Real Fog of War by Luca De Petrillo and its NWN continuation by Mlie. Apache License 2.0.
